facts.statement: The genus Palaeotriakis was described by Guinot, Underwood, Cappetta, and Ward in 2013.
The genus Palaeotriakis includes two species that were originally classified as species of Paratriakis.
facts.quote: This genus includes two species that are originally described as species of Paratriakis.

facts.statement: Palaeotriakis curtirostris was originally described by Davis in 1887.
Palaeotriakis subserratus was described by Underwood and Ward in 2008.
Later studies support the classification of Palaeotriakis curtirostris as a species of Paratriakis rather than Palaeotriakis.
facts.quote: However, for P. curtirostris, later studies still support its classification as a species of Paratriakis.

facts.statement: Palaeotriakis belongs to the family Triakidae.
Palaeotriakis is classified within the class Chondrichthyes.
Palaeotriakis subserratus is the type species of the genus Palaeotriakis.
Palaeotriakis lived between 85.7 and 72.2 million years ago, from the Santonian to the Campanian stages.
facts.quote: Time range: Santonian to Campanian (85.7 to 72.2 million years ago)

facts.statement: There are six recorded fossil occurrences of Palaeotriakis.

rejected.statement: Palaeotriakis was a genus of ground sharks that lived in France during the Late Cretaceous period.
rejected.quote: Paleotriakis is a genus of ground sharks that lived in the Late Cretaceous period of France.
